title: Preparing the oracle service phase
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine, let $C$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with at least one work tape, and choose states $en,ex$ of $C$. For every Boolean input word $x$, configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$, and Boolean $side$, if $c$ is in the query state and its query-head position lies on the side specified by $side$, then there is a time $t$ no greater than the absolute value of that position plus $5$ at which the host machine, started from the stable configuration determined by $c$ and $side$, is in the service phase sweeping from the ready configuration formed using $c$’s query-tape contents and query-head position, with empty argument word and output unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine
$C$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$C$ has at least one work tape
the query-head position lies on the side specified by $side$
caveat: The conclusion’s host configuration is a precise machine encoding; the prose describes its service phase and ready configuration, including the empty argument and unchanged output.
